storylines.title: The Road Trip to Marara Camp Thika

episodes.hook: Packing the squad for Thika Road
episodes.context: Debating who gets the aux cable and who is bringing the cold sodas to Marara Camp Thika.
episodes.prompt_hint: Talk about the squad loading up the car for the festival, fighting over playlist control, and realizing the early bird tiers on the Goodlife website are moving fast.
episodes.cliffhanger: Wait, did anyone actually download the passes, or are we going to be explaining ourselves at the gate?

episodes.hook: The scent of Nyama Choma hits the highway
episodes.context: Pulling up near Marara Camp, hearing the bass bin vibrations from 2km away.
episodes.prompt_hint: Hype the open skies, the outdoor grills, and the crowd energy already building up at Marara Camp.
episodes.cliffhanger: Security checks the passes... but what did Brian leave back in the boot?

episodes.hook: Full festival energy under the stars
episodes.context: The headline DJ drops the biggest track of the night.
episodes.prompt_hint: Talk about the pure vibe, lights, and heavy sound at Marara Camp Thika. Remind listeners who missed out to lock in for the next edition.
episodes.cliffhanger: The track hits, the crowd roars... and who just lost their shoe in the dancefloor?

storylines.title: Cinema Popcorn Heist vs Festival Vibes

episodes.context: Sitting in a dead-quiet cinema hall paying crazy money for small popcorn versus hitting the festival.
episodes.prompt_hint: Compare exorbitant cinema snack prices to grabbing legit hot roadside samosas or festival grills.
episodes.cliffhanger: If you try sneaking in hot samosas into the movie theater, does Thanos hear the crunch?

episodes.context: Why outdoor festivals beat dark cinema screens every single time.
episodes.prompt_hint: Urge listeners to get outside under the open skies at Marara Camp instead of being trapped in air conditioning.
episodes.cliffhanger: So what is the move: movie screen in the dark, or bassline under the stars with your mbogi?
